name: io.github.rehmthegreat/foodpanda-ai-mcp
title: foodpanda
description: Read-only access to foodpanda restaurant discovery data across 10 markets: search restaurants, read menus and prices, compare delivery fees and minimums, browse cuisines, find deals and check opening hours. No API key, no account, no ordering.

environmentVariables.name: FOODPANDA_DEFAULT_MARKET
environmentVariables.description: Default two-letter market code used when a tool call does not specify one. One of: pk, bd, my, sg, ph, tw, hk, kh, la, mm.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity: error, warn, info, debug or silent. Logs are written to stderr only.

environmentVariables.name: FOODPANDA_RATE_LIMIT_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Sustained upstream requests per second. Kept low on purpose: the upstream menu host is bot-protected and blocks busy IP addresses.

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Cache backend: 'memory' (default, zero config) or 'redis' (requires REDIS_URL and 'npm install redis').
